files.rationale: Contrastive criteria; each option states what it covers and which nearest-neighbour option takes the other cases.
Minimal literal definitions keyed to one observable cue each, with no cross-references.
Framed by who is portrayed and how (victim in-group, strong in-group, lesser target, mocked target, stereotyped target, threatened target), with boundary rules.
Flat choice with short literal instructions and contrastive criteria that name what separates each label from its nearest neighbour.
Coarse-to-fine hierarchy; first decide whether the post attacks through tone, harm and power, or claims about groups, then choose within the group.
One-vs-rest, where each label is judged as an independent true/false statement about the post, and the most probable wins.

writer_input: task/label definitions and the paper seed program; no data examples, no gold labels
